title: Linked copy-paste procedures for the remaining owner actions
goal: B-008, F-004, F-009, F-011, F-015 and F-023 each link one copy-paste procedure from their human-action line and Reproduce row
acceptance: One procedure page per owner action under docs/acceptance/, with the right shell per machine and the expected result per block
Each human-action line and Reproduce row links it; no 'below', 'in details' or bare path remains
privacy: No tokens, hostnames beyond the named machines, or personal data in procedures.
escalation: A procedure that needs a device or account the agent cannot describe from evidence goes to the owner as a question

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-12: about 25 minutes per procedure for six, drafted from each record's existing evidence, plus links and checks. Not a measurement.
